neighborhoods.name: Town Green
neighborhoods.notes: town centre conservation area, listed buildings

property_mix.notable: Historic market town character with 19th-century core; significant student and HMO activity around Edge Hill University

locksmith_relevant: Town Green conservation area contains period sash windows and original locks requiring specialist repair and sympathetic replacement.
High student population and rental density drive demand for emergency callouts, rekeying, and multi-occupancy security upgrades.
Victorian and Edwardian terraces common across Ormskirk; many have original doors needing reinforcement or modern lock installation without damage.
